# Autonomous EHS Management

> Self-hosted EHS console for incidents, CAPA, audits, and TRIR-style metrics. PostgreSQL is the system of record. Optional AI may suggest wording; humans close records.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): product positioning, quick start, and what “autonomous” means here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): community contract — commands, layout, Always / Ask first / Never
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting (do not file public issues for active findings)
- [docs/ai-governed-intake.md](docs/ai-governed-intake.md): proposal-only AI; humans close records
- [docs/architecture-map.md](docs/architecture-map.md): system map and PostgreSQL system of record
